verdict.rationale: SigNoz has no evidenced built-in AI that investigates alerts. Instead it offers an official MCP server and Agent Skills that let external agents (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) query metrics, logs, traces and alerts in natural language. Its AI use-case docs list scenarios such as "Investigate What Changed After a Deploy" and "Tune a Noisy Alert", so investigation is possible only by bringing your own agent. Missing for 10: a native in-platform AI that investigates an alert or error, explicit probable-root-cause output, detailed docs on the investigation workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
